high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Tim Cook, the CEO of Apple, on X (formerly Twitter). The tweet reads: "Thanks to @akiyaspin for showing me the Hie Shrine in Tokyo. It was an honor to visit and learn about its enduring legacy." The photo accompanying the tweet shows two individuals standing in front of a traditional Japanese shrine. The person on the left appears to be Tim Cook, recognizable by his glasses and white shirt. He has one hand on his hip and is smiling. The person on the right is holding up a smartphone, seemingly taking a selfie with the shrine in the background.
